Originally located on Ham Long Street in Hoan Kiem District, the museum was relocated in 2010 to its current site beside the National Convention Center on Pham Hung Street in Nam Tu Liem District.

Originally located on Ham Long Street in Hoan Kiem District, the museum was relocated in 2010 to its current site beside the National Convention Center on Pham Hung Street in Nam Tu Liem District. This strategic move not only enhanced its accessibility but also provided a more spacious and modern setting for its extensive collections and exhibitions.

Covering an expansive area of 54,000 square meters, the Hanoi Museum is a striking architectural marvel designed with two underground floors and four above-ground levels, resembling an inverted pyramid that gradually widens as it ascends. The structure's unique design not only captures attention but also optimizes space for diverse exhibits and interactive displays.
